blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Northern Samar mourned the death of Raul Daza, a political titan who served the province as governor and congressman for decades, with local leaders honoring his legacy of public service, democratic principles, and contributions to the province’s development. Daza, 91, died on Monday, Oct. 12, after a lingering illness, his family announced on Thursday. His passing marked the end of a political career spanning more than five decades and left a legacy that continues through his grandson, Rep. Nikko Raul Daza, who now represents Northern Samar’s first congressional district. Northern Samar Gov. Christopher Harris Ongchuan paid tribute to […]...
